_說明: 兵種圖鑑資料（第二輪方案 R3）。數值不在這裡：一律從 unit_defs.gd 讀。技能說明的 {常數名} 會在執行時換成 unit_defs 的數值。示範 demos 用真的戰鬥模擬跑：blue／red 是 [兵種, 欄(藍方 0～5，5 前排；紅方寫藍方視角，自動鏡像), 列]，expect 是這段一定要出現的事件標籤，ticks 是最長 tick 數。故事採三方建議的混搭：主故事＝角色個性風（Antigravity），口號與老兵筆記＝生活小事風（Codex）。

units.story_zh: 王國裡最準時上下班的模範步兵。頭盔上的小藍羽是媽媽縫的，短劍磨得亮晶晶。最喜歡找舉大盾的傢伙比力氣；背後有黑影靠近時，也會毫不猶豫轉身回一劍。
units.story_en: The kingdom's most punctual foot soldier. Mom sewed the little blue plume on the helmet; the short sword is polished to a shine. Loves testing strength against big shields — and spins around the moment a shadow creeps up behind.
units.tagline_en: I'll go first — save me a snack!
units.good_zh: 放在盾兵旁邊的前排，專門去敲對面的盾牆；身後有刺客威脅時特別好用。
units.good_en: Front row next to your shields to crack the enemy wall; great when assassins threaten your back line.
units.bad_zh: 怕遠程磨血和騎兵衝撞：別讓他們孤單站在開闊的側翼。
units.bad_en: Weak to archers and cavalry charges — don't leave them alone on an open flank.
units.veteran_zh: 每天先替大家切麵包，再擦亮小劍。站上第一排時，總會回頭確認朋友都跟上了。
units.veteran_en: Slices bread for everyone before polishing the sword. Always glances back from the front row to make sure friends kept up.

units.story_zh: 原本是城門口的守衛大叔，因為力氣太大總把門把拽壞，乾脆拆了一塊厚鐵板當盾。雖然走得慢吞吞，但只要把盾往地上一插，連狂奔的小馬都會撞得眼冒金星。
units.story_en: Used to guard the city gate, but kept ripping off door handles — so now carries a slab of iron as a shield. Slow on foot, but plant that shield and even a galloping pony sees stars.
units.tagline_en: Scoot in — there's room behind me!
units.good_zh: 放最前排擋箭、擋騎兵；近戰敵人會被吸過來打它，替後排爭取時間。
units.good_en: Put them in front to stop arrows and cavalry; nearby melee enemies get pulled onto them, buying time for your back line.
units.bad_zh: 怕劍士破盾、怕刺客從背後戳：側面和背後要有人顧。
units.bad_en: Weak to swordsmen and to assassins from behind — guard their sides and back.
units.veteran_zh: 盾牌背面貼滿隊友寫的便條。風大的時候替大家擋風，箭飛來時也照辦。
units.veteran_en: The back of the shield is covered in notes from friends. Blocks the wind on breezy days — and arrows the rest of the time.

units.story_zh: 戴綠兜帽的森林視力冠軍，能看清六格外的蝴蝶翅膀。最怕騎著小馬衝過來的金髮小子；但只要瞥見斗篷露出一角，就會緊張地連射警覺箭。
units.story_en: The forest's sharpest eyes under a green hood — can spot butterfly wings six cells away. Terrified of the blond kid charging in on a pony, but the moment a cloak peeks out, the alert arrows start flying.
units.good_zh: 躲在盾牆後面的後排，越過前排拋射；對付慢吞吞的劍士和現形的刺客最拿手。
units.good_en: Behind your shield wall, lobbing over the front line; best against slow swordsmen and revealed assassins.
units.bad_zh: 箭被盾牌正面擋掉、被騎兵衝到就完了：側翼要有人擋騎兵。
units.bad_en: Arrows bounce off shields, and cavalry reaching them is a disaster — cover the flanks.
units.veteran_zh: 喜歡把遠處的松果當練習靶。眼力好到常替全隊找回掉在草裡的鈕扣。
units.veteran_en: Practices on pinecones far away. Has found every button the squad ever dropped in the grass.

units.story_zh: 金色蘑菇頭配上一匹脾氣倔強的小馬。最討厭正面排隊，總愛沿著邊邊繞去後排找弓箭手。直直跑起來就停不下來，唯獨看到大盾牌會雙腿發軟。
units.story_en: A golden mushroom haircut on a stubborn little pony. Hates waiting in line up front and loves sneaking around the edge to find archers. Once running straight there's no stopping — except at the sight of a big shield.
units.tagline_en: Hold on — we're taking the scenic route!
units.good_zh: 放在兩側中排，讓它有直線可以衝；繞過盾牆去撞對面的弓箭手。
units.good_en: Middle rows on the flanks so it has a straight run; loop around the shield wall and crash into archers.
units.bad_zh: 正面撞上盾兵會被頂住暈眩、還會被拒馬加倍痛打；也怕刺客絆馬。
units.bad_en: Charging a shield head-on gets it braced and stunned — and pikes hit it double. Assassins can trip it too.
units.veteran_zh: 小馬認得回家的路，騎士認得點心車。他們約好：衝鋒前先看清楚方向。
units.veteran_en: The pony knows the way home; the rider knows where the snack cart is. They agreed to check directions before every charge.

units.story_zh: 把紫色大兜帽拉得低低的害羞小個子，怕生所以開戰時會先憋氣隱形。最擅長偷偷繞到盾兵背後戳一下，或綁繩子絆倒小馬；被發現時會臉紅到忘記閃躲。
units.story_en: A shy little one with a big purple hood pulled low — so shy they hold their breath and vanish when battle starts. Expert at poking shields from behind and tripping ponies; when spotted, they blush so hard they forget to dodge.
units.good_zh: 放中後排，開場潛行穿過前排去切盾兵的背、絆對面的騎兵。
units.good_en: Middle-back rows: slip through the front line while stealthed to stab shields from behind and trip cavalry.
units.bad_zh: 血少：碰到劍士會被反擊，現形後被弓箭手集火很快就倒。
units.bad_en: Fragile: swordsmen counter them, and archers focus them down once revealed.
units.veteran_zh: 走路完全沒聲音，拆餅乾袋卻每次都被發現。最會替忙碌的朋友找一條安靜的小路。
units.veteran_en: Walks without a sound, yet always gets caught opening the cookie bag. Great at finding a quiet shortcut for busy friends.

units.story_zh: 村裡個子最高的孩子，偏偏最怕站第一排。銅色的扁鍋盔是外婆的湯鍋改的，長槍尖綁著紅纓，躲在盾牌哥哥後面也能戳到前面的人。看到小馬衝過來，會把槍尾往地上一頓——「停！」
units.story_en: The tallest kid in the village, and the most nervous about the front row. The copper pot-helmet used to be Grandma's soup pot; the red tassel on the pike lets everyone know where the poke is coming from. Hiding behind a big shield, it can still reach the front. When a pony charges in, it plants the butt of the pike — "Stop!"
units.tagline_en: I'm in the back — but I can reach!
units.good_zh: 放在盾兵正後方當第二排，越過前排出手；擋在騎兵會衝過來的路上。
units.good_en: Right behind your shields as a second rank, poking over the front line; put it where cavalry will charge.
units.bad_zh: 本身不耐打：被弓箭手遠遠射、被刺客摸到背後、被投彈兵炸都很痛；狂戰士破陣會讓它擋不住衝鋒。
units.bad_en: Fragile on its own: archers, assassins from behind and bombers all hurt. A berserker's breach stops it from bracing.
units.veteran_zh: 槍桿上刻了一道一道的記號：不是打贏幾場，是被小馬嚇到幾次。最近越刻越少了。
units.veteran_en: Notches on the shaft don't count wins — they count how many times a pony startled it. Lately, fewer notches.

units.story_zh: 戴著黃銅大護目鏡、圍著橘紅頭巾的發明家。肩上永遠扛著一顆冒小火花的圓滾滾火罐，最喜歡看擠成一團的盾牌一起跳起來。敵人一靠近就慌了，只會拿點火棒亂敲。
units.story_en: An inventor in big brass goggles and an orange bandana, always shouldering a round pot with a fizzing fuse. Loves watching a packed shield wall hop all at once. Gets flustered the moment anyone comes close — then it's just frantic bonking with the lighter stick.
units.good_zh: 放在最後排，專炸對面擠在一起的盾牆、醫者和鼓手；火罐從上面落下，舉盾擋不住。
units.good_en: Back row, lobbing into packed shield walls, medics and drummers; the pot falls from above, so shields don't help.
units.bad_zh: {C:BOMB_MIN} 格內有敵人就只能敲人：騎兵、刺客貼上來最怕；弓箭手射得比它遠。
units.bad_en: With an enemy inside {C:BOMB_MIN} cells it can only bonk: cavalry and assassins up close are its nightmare, and archers outrange it.
units.veteran_zh: 它說護目鏡是為了安全。大家都知道，其實是為了看起來很帥。
units.veteran_en: It says the goggles are for safety. Everyone knows they're for looking cool.

units.role_en: Back-line healer, keeps the front alive
units.story_zh: 戴著印了綠十字的白色高帽，手上的長杖頂端會發綠光。戰場上它一刀也不揮，眼睛只盯著誰的血最少，跟在後面一路小跑。隊友都走光了，才會氣呼呼地拿杖子敲人。
units.story_en: A tall white hat with a green cross and a staff whose tip glows green. It never swings at anyone — its eyes are only on whoever's lowest, trotting along behind them. Only when the whole team is gone does it angrily bonk someone with the staff.
units.good_zh: 放在前排後面，讓盾兵、劍士撐得更久；搭配很多戰鬥兵才有用。
units.good_en: Behind the front line so shields and swords last longer; it needs plenty of fighters around to be worth it.
units.bad_zh: 騎兵、刺客會專門繞過來找它；擠在一起會被投彈兵一起炸。多個醫者補同一隻不會疊加，狂熱後補血減半。
units.bad_en: Cavalry and assassins go out of their way to find it; huddled up, a bomber gets everyone. Multiple medics on one target don't stack, and frenzy halves healing.
units.veteran_zh: 藥箱裡一半是繃帶，一半是糖果。它說兩種都是藥。
units.veteran_en: Half the kit is bandages, half is candy. It insists both are medicine.

units.story_zh: 羽毛帽是全軍最高的，胸前掛著比自己還圓的大鼓。咚、咚、咚——鼓聲一響，旁邊的人手腳都跟著快起來。它自己不打架，只負責讓大家打得更起勁。
units.story_en: The tallest feathered hat in the army and a drum rounder than itself. Boom, boom, boom — when it plays, everyone nearby moves a little faster. It doesn't fight; it just makes everyone fight harder.
units.good_zh: 放在陣型中間，{C:DRUM_RANGE} 格內的友軍攻擊都變快；身邊的戰鬥兵越多越划算。
units.good_en: In the middle of the formation: allies within {C:DRUM_RANGE} cells attack faster. The more fighters around it, the better.
units.bad_zh: 站在人群中間，正好是投彈兵最喜歡的位置；刺客也會摸過來。兩個鼓手的範圍重疊不會疊加。
units.bad_en: The middle of a crowd is exactly where bombers aim, and assassins sneak in. Two drummers' ranges don't stack.
units.veteran_zh: 它打的不是戰鼓，是早餐鈴。大家只是剛好都很餓。
units.veteran_en: It's not a war drum, it's the breakfast bell. Everyone just happens to be hungry.

units.story_zh: 一頭火紅刺蝟頭、披著毛茸茸的獸皮，左右手各一把大斧。它不在乎自己砍了多少，只要把對面的大盾劈出裂縫，後面的弓箭手和劍士就能一擁而上。被小馬撞到也紋風不動。
units.story_en: A fiery spiky head, a fluffy pelt and a big axe in each hand. It doesn't care how much damage it does — it just splits the enemy's shields so the archers and swords behind can pour in. Even a charging pony can't budge it.
units.tagline_en: Nice shield. Mind if I borrow it?
units.good_zh: 帶去打盾牆：打中盾兵或長槍兵後 {S:BREACH_TICKS} 秒內，它們不能嘲諷、舉盾擋不住箭、長槍兵擋不住衝鋒。記得配弓箭手一起上。
units.good_en: Bring it against shield walls: for {S:BREACH_TICKS} s after a hit, shields and pikes can't taunt, shields stop blocking arrows, and pikes can't brace. Pair it with archers.
units.bad_zh: 沒穿甲，被弓箭射 ×{BERSERK_ARROW_NUM}/{BERSERK_ARROW_DEN}；自己的傷害普通，單獨上場打不贏。
units.bad_en: No armor — arrows deal ×{BERSERK_ARROW_NUM}/{BERSERK_ARROW_DEN}. Its own damage is ordinary; alone, it won't win.
units.veteran_zh: 斧頭有名字，一把叫早安、一把叫晚安。沒有人敢問中午怎麼辦。
units.veteran_en: The axes have names: Good Morning and Good Night. Nobody dares ask about lunch.

units.story_zh: 住在森林裡的蘑菇，被傭兵公會的傳單騙來當兵。它不會走路，也懶得走路，只要有人踩進它的地盤，就噗地噴一口孢子。隊友都說它是全軍最穩的同事，因為它真的不會動。
units.story_en: A forest mushroom lured in by a guild flyer. It can't walk and wouldn't want to. Step on its turf and it puffs out spores. Teammates call it the steadiest soldier around, because it truly never moves.
units.good_zh: 放在敵人必經之路上，逼他們慢慢走；配弓箭手就是一條死亡走廊。
units.good_en: On the enemy's path to slow them down; with archers behind it, that's a death corridor.
units.bad_zh: 弓箭手和投彈兵站在圈外就能打它；奇襲兵不算主力，要帶戰鬥兵。
units.bad_en: Archers and bombers hit it from outside the cloud; raiders aren't a main force, so bring fighters.
units.veteran_zh: 下雨天心情最好，還會長胖一圈。
units.veteran_en: Happiest in the rain — it even gets a little plumper.

units.story_zh: 牧場裡最有衝勁的羊，頭上那根引線是它自己點的，沒人知道為什麼。它只知道往前衝，撞到東西就碰的一聲，羊毛飄滿天。下一場它又回來了，也沒人知道為什麼。
units.story_en: The ranch's most driven sheep. It lit that fuse itself, nobody knows why. It only knows how to charge, and whatever it hits goes boom with wool everywhere. It's back next battle, and nobody knows why.
units.good_zh: 撞盾牆和密集陣最有效；和吸塵貓一起用，敵人會自己擠成一團等你炸。
units.good_en: Best against shield walls and tight formations; with a Vacuum Cat, enemies clump up for you.
units.bad_zh: 別貼著自己主力放：半路被打死的爆炸連友軍都傷；弓箭手、長槍兵會提早解決它。
units.bad_en: Don't place it against your own troops — shot down early, it hurts allies too. Archers and pikes stop it early.
units.veteran_zh: 引線其實只有三公分，它一直以為自己很長。
units.veteran_en: The fuse is barely an inch. It thinks it's much longer.

units.story_zh: 它是一個箱子，大家都這麼以為。其實裡面只有舌頭和很多牙齒。它最喜歡的時刻，是有人靠過來想看看裡面有什麼。答案是：你。
units.story_en: It's a chest, or so everyone thinks. Inside it's just a tongue and lots of teeth. Its favorite moment is when someone leans in to see what's inside. The answer is: you.
units.good_zh: 放在陣前空地當誘餌，騎兵和刺客衝進來就吃大虧。
units.good_en: As bait on open ground in front; cavalry and assassins pay for charging in.
units.bad_zh: 範圍傷害打得到偽裝中的它；全場沒人靠近時就白花錢。
units.bad_en: Splash damage still hits it while disguised; if nobody comes close, it's wasted gold.
units.veteran_zh: 有人問它裡面到底有沒有寶物，它自己也很想知道。
units.veteran_en: Asked whether there's really treasure inside, it says it'd like to know too.

units.role_en: The front line that keeps coming
units.story_zh: 一團黏黏的東西，對任何事都很樂觀。被砍成兩半時它會說「太好了，多一個朋友」。小史萊姆長大後會忘記對方，然後在下一場互相打招呼。
units.story_en: A cheerful blob, optimistic about everything. Cut in half, it says, "Great, one more friend." The slimelets forget each other and say hello again next battle.
units.tagline_zh: 我們是一夥的，也是兩夥的
units.good_zh: 放前排吸收火力；對單體高攻的刺客、劍士特別划算。
units.good_en: Up front to soak hits; great value against high single-target damage like assassins and swordsmen.
units.bad_zh: 範圍傷害會把小的一起掃掉，投彈兵是天敵。
units.bad_en: Splash sweeps up the little ones too; bombers are its natural enemy.
units.veteran_zh: 最怕冬天，會結凍，然後裂成三隻。
units.veteran_en: Hates winter: it freezes, and splits into three.

units.story_zh: 它不記得自己怎麼死的，只記得還有東西沒吃完。穿過前排時它會小聲說「借過」，然後直直飄到弓箭手面前，弓箭手通常會射它，箭會穿過去，弓箭手通常會哭。
units.story_en: It can't recall how it died, only that it left a snack unfinished. Slipping through the front line, it whispers "excuse me," drifts up to the archer, gets shot, the arrow passes through, and the archer usually cries.
units.tagline_en: Excuse me, I'm in a hurry.
units.good_zh: 放中間，它會自己穿過前排找弓箭手、投彈兵和支援兵。
units.good_en: In the middle; it slips past the front line to hunt archers, bombers and support.
units.bad_zh: 不受嘲諷也擋不住，但怕近戰：被劍士、盾兵打傷害 ×1.5，血又少。
units.bad_en: Taunts don't work on it, but melee does: swords and shields deal ×1.5 and it has little health.
units.veteran_zh: 每次開戰都想打招呼，但沒有人看得到它的手。
units.veteran_en: It always waves before battle. Nobody sees the hand.

units.story_zh: 一個被遺忘在閣樓的布偶，頭上那根針從沒拔掉。它不會打架，它只會把自己受的痛分給正前方那個人。它不恨任何人，它只是覺得大家要公平一點。
units.story_en: A doll forgotten in an attic, with a pin it never took out. It can't really fight. It just shares its pain with whoever is straight ahead. It doesn't hate anyone. It just thinks things should be fair.
units.good_zh: 擺在想綁的敵人正對面；對狂戰士、騎兵這種高攻高價的最痛。
units.good_en: Directly across from the enemy you want to bind; hurts high-damage, costly units like berserkers and cavalry most.
units.bad_zh: 孢子菇的毒和弓箭手的箭慢慢磨死它，轉過去的傷也很小。
units.bad_en: Poison and arrows wear it down slowly, and little damage passes on.
units.veteran_zh: 有人想幫它拔針，它說不要，那是它的髮型。
units.veteran_en: Someone offered to remove the pin. It refused: it's a hairstyle.

units.role_en: Time stop at the clutch moment
units.story_zh: 一隻從時鐘店逃出來的小精靈，沙子流完就會打瞌睡。隊友快撐不住的時候，它會用力敲一下自己的玻璃，全場安靜兩秒。它覺得兩秒夠長了，反正大家都很急。
units.story_en: A little sprite that fled a clock shop and nods off when the sand runs out. When allies are failing, it knocks on its own glass and everything goes quiet for two seconds. It thinks two seconds is plenty, since everyone's always in a hurry.
units.good_zh: 放主力中央，要 2 隻以上友軍殘血才會發動，對方的爆發會被它打斷。
units.good_en: In the middle of your main force. It fires only when 2 or more nearby allies are badly hurt, and it interrupts the enemy's burst.
units.bad_zh: 每場只有一次；刺客和幽靈會先找它，太早死就白費。
units.bad_en: Only once per battle; assassins and ghosts go for it first, and dying early wastes it.
units.veteran_zh: 最大的煩惱是怕被倒過來放。
units.veteran_en: Its biggest fear is being turned upside down.

units.story_zh: 生前是圖書館員，死後還在借書給人。它翻開那本紫色的書，倒下的人就會站起來，雖然只剩三成血，雖然有點不太記得自己是誰。它都會記得提醒他們還書。
units.story_en: A librarian in life, still lending books in death. It opens the purple book and the fallen stand back up — with a third of their health, and a bit confused about who they are. It always reminds them to return the book.
units.good_zh: 放後排，前排倒得越多越划算，打持久戰、翻盤用。
units.good_en: In the back; the more of your front line falls, the better. Made for long fights and comebacks.
units.bad_zh: 血少，刺客和騎兵會直接來找它；骷髏不能再被復活。
units.bad_en: Fragile, and assassins and cavalry come straight for it; skeletons can't be raised again.
units.veteran_zh: 書其實是食譜，它從來沒翻到正確的那一頁。
units.veteran_en: The book is actually a cookbook. It has never found the right page.

units.story_zh: 它只是想把家裡打掃乾淨，後來發現戰場比較髒。背上的吸塵器力道大到連人都吸得動。敵人被吸成一團的時候，它會很滿意地坐下來舔爪子，然後某隻羊就來了。
units.story_en: It only wanted a clean house, then noticed battlefields are dirtier. The vacuum on its back pulls hard enough to move people. Once enemies are clumped together it sits down to lick a paw, and then a sheep arrives.
units.good_zh: 放在陷阱中央，配爆爆羊、投彈兵；能把對方後排拖出來。
units.good_en: In the middle of your trap, with Boom Sheep or bombers; it can drag out the enemy back line.
units.bad_zh: 血不多，弓箭手和刺客會先解決它；騎兵和石魔只會被拉一半。
units.bad_en: Not much health, so archers and assassins take it out first; cavalry and golems are only pulled half as far.
units.veteran_zh: 集塵袋從來沒倒過，裡面可能有一個失蹤的傭兵。
units.veteran_en: The dust bag has never been emptied. A missing mercenary may be in there.

units.story_zh: 山裡一塊很有上進心的石頭。它想看看世界，但走很慢，所以到現在只看過這片戰場。拍地的時候它其實只是想站穩一點。
units.story_en: An ambitious rock from the mountains. It wanted to see the world, but it walks so slowly this battlefield is all it has seen. When it stomps, it's really just trying to keep its balance.
units.good_zh: 放前排當牆，把騎兵、劍士拍開；死後的碎石區還能再擋一陣子。
units.good_en: Up front as a wall, stomping cavalry and swordsmen back; its rubble slows enemies even after it falls.
units.bad_zh: 9 金很貴又慢；狂戰士和刺客專門對付它。
units.bad_en: Costly at 9 gold and slow; berserkers and assassins are built to handle it.
units.veteran_zh: 有人在它肩上種了花，它走路更小心了。
units.veteran_en: Someone planted flowers on its shoulder. It walks more carefully now.

sword_counter.desc_zh: 被刺客打到時立刻回砍一刀（攻擊的 {COUNTER_PCT}%，每 tick 最多一次，不佔自己的攻擊間隔）。
sword_counter.desc_en: Instantly strikes back when hit by an assassin ({COUNTER_PCT}% damage, once per tick, doesn't use its own cooldown).

shield_block.desc_zh: 正面被箭射中，傷害 ×{BLOCK_NUM}/{BLOCK_DEN}；從背後射就擋不住。
shield_block.desc_en: Arrows from the front deal ×{BLOCK_NUM}/{BLOCK_DEN}; arrows from behind get through.

shield_brace.desc_zh: 正面被衝鋒時，騎兵暈眩 {STUN_TICKS} tick、衝鋒不加成。
shield_brace.desc_en: A cavalry charge from the front stuns the rider for {STUN_TICKS} ticks and deals no bonus.

shield_taunt.desc_zh: {C:TAUNT_RANGE} 格以內的近戰敵人會優先打它。
shield_taunt.desc_en: Melee enemies within {C:TAUNT_RANGE} cells must attack it first.

archer_lob.desc_zh: 射程 {C:REACH_2} 格，越過前排直接射後面的敵人。
archer_lob.desc_en: Range {C:REACH_2} cells; lobs over the front line.

archer_alert.desc_zh: 射程內有現形的刺客時優先射它，傷害 ×{ALERT_NUM}/{ALERT_DEN}。
archer_alert.desc_en: Prioritizes revealed assassins in range, dealing ×{ALERT_NUM}/{ALERT_DEN}.

cav_charge.desc_zh: 直直跑超過 {C:CHARGE_NEED} 格後的第一擊 ×{CHARGE_NUM}/{CHARGE_DEN}，還會擊退。被推開、轉彎或停下來都要重新跑。
cav_charge.desc_en: After a straight run of {C:CHARGE_NEED} cells, the first hit deals ×{CHARGE_NUM}/{CHARGE_DEN} and knocks back. Being pushed, turning or stopping resets it.

cav_flank.desc_zh: 要去找的弓手前面有盾兵擋路時，先往敵人比較少、而且有空間的那一側繞，繞到了就不再回頭。
cav_flank.desc_en: If shields block the path to its archer target, it loops around the less crowded side with room to spare — and never doubles back.

assassin_stealth.desc_zh: 開場 {STEALTH_TICKS} tick 不能被選為目標、不會被推擠，會繞到目標背後；出手就現形。
assassin_stealth.desc_en: For the first {STEALTH_TICKS} ticks it can't be targeted or pushed and circles behind its target; attacking reveals it.

assassin_backstab.desc_zh: 從背後攻擊 ×{BACKSTAB_NUM}/{BACKSTAB_DEN}，而且無視舉盾。
assassin_backstab.desc_en: Attacks from behind deal ×{BACKSTAB_NUM}/{BACKSTAB_DEN} and ignore shields.

assassin_trip.desc_zh: 打到騎兵讓它減速（×{SLOW_NUM}/{SLOW_DEN}）{SLOW_TICKS} tick，重複打只刷新不疊加。
assassin_trip.desc_en: Hitting cavalry slows it (×{SLOW_NUM}/{SLOW_DEN}) for {SLOW_TICKS} ticks; refreshes, doesn't stack.

pike_reach.desc_zh: 攻擊距離 {C:REACH_5} 格，站在自家前排後面也能越過去刺到敵人。
pike_reach.desc_en: Reach of {C:REACH_5} cells — it can poke past your own front line.

pike_brace.desc_zh: 騎兵從正面衝鋒打到它時，衝鋒倍率和擊退都沒用（衝鋒照樣用掉）。
pike_brace.desc_en: A frontal cavalry charge loses its damage bonus and knockback (and the charge is still spent).

bomb_lob.desc_zh: 射程 {C:REACH_6} 格。主目標吃全額，周圍 {C:SPLASH_R} 格內最多 {SPLASH_MAX} 隻吃 {SPLASH_DMG} 點波及；從上面落下，舉盾擋不住，打盾兵還 ×{BOMB_SHIELD_NUM}/{BOMB_SHIELD_DEN}。
bomb_lob.desc_en: Range {C:REACH_6} cells. Full damage to the target, plus {SPLASH_DMG} splash to up to {SPLASH_MAX} enemies within {C:SPLASH_R} cells. It falls from above — shields don't block it, and shields take ×{BOMB_SHIELD_NUM}/{BOMB_SHIELD_DEN}.

bomb_bonk.desc_zh: {C:BOMB_MIN} 格內有看得見的敵人時不能丟火罐，只能用點火棒敲（攻擊 {BONK_ATK}）。
bomb_bonk.desc_en: With a visible enemy inside {C:BOMB_MIN} cells it can't throw — it just bonks with the lighter stick ({BONK_ATK} damage).

medic_heal.desc_zh: 每 {S:HEAL_CD} 秒補一次：{C:HEAL_RANGE} 格內血量比例最低的友軍 +{HEAL_AMT}（不補自己、不超過滿血）。多個醫者補同一隻不疊加；狂熱後減半；當下已經倒下的救不回來。
medic_heal.desc_en: Every {S:HEAL_CD} s: heals the lowest-health ally within {C:HEAL_RANGE} cells for {HEAL_AMT} (not itself, never over max). Medics don't stack on one target, frenzy halves it, and the fallen can't be saved.

medic_support.desc_zh: 隊上還有戰鬥兵時完全不攻擊，跟在最需要補血的隊友後面；只剩支援兵時才自己動手。
medic_support.desc_en: Never attacks while fighters remain — it follows whoever needs healing most. Only fights when nothing but support is left.

drum_beat.desc_zh: {C:DRUM_RANGE} 格內的友軍（含自己）攻擊冷卻每 tick 多扣 {DRUM_BONUS}（平常扣 4，所以出手變快）；兩個鼓手不疊加，冷卻扣除最多 {DEC_CAP}。被暈時停鼓。
drum_beat.desc_en: Allies within {C:DRUM_RANGE} cells (itself included) recover {DRUM_BONUS} extra cooldown per tick (normally 4), so they attack faster. Two drummers don't stack; recovery caps at {DEC_CAP}. Stops while stunned.

bers_breach.desc_zh: 打中盾兵或長槍兵時，那隻和 {C:BREACH_SPREAD} 格內的敵方盾兵、長槍兵一起破陣 {S:BREACH_TICKS} 秒：不能嘲諷、正面舉盾擋不住箭、長槍兵擋不住衝鋒，而且受到所有傷害 ×{BREACH_VULN_NUM}/{BREACH_VULN_DEN}。
bers_breach.desc_en: When it hits a shield or pike, that unit and every enemy shield or pike within {C:BREACH_SPREAD} cell are breached for {S:BREACH_TICKS} s: no taunt, shields stop blocking arrows, pikes can't brace, and they take ×{BREACH_VULN_NUM}/{BREACH_VULN_DEN} damage from everything.

bers_steady.desc_zh: 騎兵衝鋒撞不退它（傷害照吃）。
bers_steady.desc_en: Cavalry charges can't knock it back (damage still lands).

spore_poison.desc_zh: {C:REACH_10} 格內的敵兵每秒毒 {SPORE_DMG} 點、移速變慢；多朵孢子菇不疊加。
spore_poison.desc_en: Enemies within {C:REACH_10} cells take {SPORE_DMG} poison per second and slow down. Several Sporecaps don't stack.

sheep_blast.desc_zh: 碰到敵人就炸，{C:BLAST_R} 格內的敵人受傷；半路被打死會在原地小爆炸，友軍也會受傷。
sheep_blast.desc_en: Explodes on contact, hitting enemies within {C:BLAST_R} cells. Shot down on the way, it makes a smaller blast that hurts allies too.

mimic_bite.desc_zh: 偽裝中不會被選為目標（範圍傷害打得到）。敵人進 {C:MIMIC_TRIGGER} 格內就現身，咬 {BITE_DMG} 點並回 {BITE_HEAL} 血。
mimic_bite.desc_en: Can't be targeted while disguised (splash still hits). When an enemy comes within {C:MIMIC_TRIGGER} cell, it bites for {BITE_DMG} and heals {BITE_HEAL}.

slime_split.desc_zh: 死掉裂成 {SLIME_KIDS} 隻小史萊姆，小的不再分裂。
slime_split.desc_en: Splits into {SLIME_KIDS} slimelets on death. Slimelets don't split again.

ghost_phase.desc_zh: 穿過所有兵、不受嘲諷，優先打遠程和支援。箭和火罐無效，受近戰 ×{GHOST_MELEE_NUM}/{GHOST_MELEE_DEN}。
ghost_phase.desc_en: Passes through units and ignores taunts, hunting ranged and support first. Immune to arrows and fire pots; takes ×{GHOST_MELEE_NUM}/{GHOST_MELEE_DEN} from melee.

doll_voodoo.desc_zh: 綁定正前方（同列 {C:DOLL_LANE} 格內）最近的敵人，自己受的傷一半轉給對方；對方死了 {S:DOLL_REBIND} 秒後重綁。
doll_voodoo.desc_en: Binds the nearest enemy straight ahead (within {C:DOLL_LANE} cells of its row) and passes it half the damage taken. Rebinds {S:DOLL_REBIND} seconds after the target dies.

sprite_stop.desc_zh: 每場一次：{C:SPRITE_R} 格內有 {SPRITE_NEED} 隻以上友軍血量低於 {SPRITE_LOW_PCT}% 時，{S:WINDUP} 秒前搖後定住周圍敵人 {S:SPRITE_STUN} 秒，友軍受傷減半。
sprite_stop.desc_en: Once per battle: when {SPRITE_NEED}+ allies within {C:SPRITE_R} cells fall below {SPRITE_LOW_PCT}% health, after a {S:WINDUP}s windup it freezes nearby enemies for {S:SPRITE_STUN}s and halves damage to allies.

bone_raise.desc_zh: 每 {S:BONE_CD} 秒把 {C:BONE_R} 格內一具友軍屍體變成骷髏（最多 {BONE_KIDS} 隻），血量是原本的 {BONE_HP_PCT}%。
bone_raise.desc_en: Every {S:BONE_CD}s it raises an ally corpse within {C:BONE_R} cells as a skeleton (up to {BONE_KIDS}) at {BONE_HP_PCT}% health.

cat_vacuum.desc_zh: 每 {S:CAT_CD} 秒把 {C:CAT_R} 格內的敵人往身前拉最多 {C:CAT_PULL} 格；騎兵和石魔減半，孢子菇拉不動。
cat_vacuum.desc_en: Every {S:CAT_CD}s it pulls enemies within {C:CAT_R} cells up to {C:CAT_PULL} cells toward its front. Cavalry and golems move half as far; Sporecaps don't move.

golem_stomp.desc_zh: 每 {S:GOLEM_CD} 秒拍地，{C:GOLEM_R} 格內的敵人被擊退 {C:GOLEM_KNOCK} 格。死後留下 {S:ROCK_TICKS} 秒的碎石區，敵人在裡面變慢、騎兵衝鋒中斷。
golem_stomp.desc_en: Stomps every {S:GOLEM_CD}s, knocking enemies within {C:GOLEM_R} cells back {C:GOLEM_KNOCK} cells. Leaves rubble for {S:ROCK_TICKS}s when it falls: enemies slow down there and cavalry charges break.
